# Scripts and Tools Prompt

Inventory deterministic utilities, commands, adapters, APIs, and tool-use sequences without executing untrusted code.

Record purpose, interface, runtime, dependencies, permissions, network behavior, credentials by name only, side effects, error contracts, portability, tests, license, and integrity hash. Distinguish a reusable algorithm from a source-specific implementation.

Unsafe, broken, opaque, or unverifiable scripts remain quarantined candidates and should be routed to `skill-doctor` before reuse.
